subject: science
concept: Understanding a food web as multiple connected food chains
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Ecosystems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student connects several organism cards with strings/arrows to build a simple food web from multiple chains
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies all the organisms connected to a specific organism in a pictured food web
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a food web is different from a single food chain

misconception_flags: treats a food web as just one long chain rather than multiple interconnected ones

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
